entries.reason: `IF OPENED-DATE-ATTEMPTS > 100` (GENERATE-OPENED-DATE, performed UNTIL OPENED-DATE-VALID = 'Y', line 730) needs 100 draws in a row where the opened year is not above the birth year (line 912). The year is ((2014 - CUSTOMER-BIRTH-YEAR) * FUNCTION RANDOM) + CUSTOMER-BIRTH-YEAR (lines 892-895) and the birth year is drawn from 1900-1999 (line 527), so a draw fails only when FUNCTION RANDOM is under 1 / (2014 - birth year), at most 1/15: 100 in a row has probability under 15^-100 and the PARM seed cannot be searched to it. Not a logical impossibility: reviewed as unreachable in practice, to be kept under owner review.
